fastgrep

¶

fastgrep is a line-oriented search tool that recursively searches the current directory for a regex pattern, respecting gitignore rules, and skipping hidden files.

It is fast because it uses finite automata, SIMD, and aggressive literal optimizations, so most searches finish before you notice.

Installation

$ cargo install fastgrep
$ fg --version

Benchmarks

ToolTime
fastgrep0.08s
grep0.71s

See the benchmark notes for the method, the corpus, and the hardware used.
